text.en: Believing every charge distribution has a nonzero dipole moment as its leading far-field term — whenever the total charge (monopole moment) is nonzero, the monopole term dominates at large distances and the dipole term is only a smaller correction to it, not the leading behaviour.
text.et: Arvamus, et igal laengujaotusel on nullist erinev dipoolmoment kui oma juhtiv kaugväljaliige — kui kogulaeng (monopoolmoment) on nullist erinev, domineerib suurtel kaugustel monopoolliige ja dipoolliige on sellele ainult väiksem parandus, mitte juhtiv käitumine.
